recipe.visualDefinition: A group of four men in urban streetwear posing on motorcycles against a bright coastal background, featuring a large 3D metallic monogram and script typography in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame
Contrast between dark clothing/motorcycles and bright blue sky
Large 3D monogram acts as a backdrop for the script title
Horizontal alignment of the secondary title at the bottom
coreInvariants: Bright daylight lighting with high-contrast shadows
Low-angle perspective to emphasize the subjects
Metallic texture on the primary graphic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a staggered horizontal line, filling the mid-ground and foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure leaning forward on the motorcycle, flanked by the large metallic logo above.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright script title at the top, down to the central figure, then across the group to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is primarily open sky, providing space for the large graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue sky and dark black clothing/motorcycles create the primary tonal structure.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White script and metallic silver graphics provide high-value contrast against the sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and orange motorcycle indicators provide small pops of warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue sky with deep, crushed blacks in the shadows of the subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a fluid, brush-like script with connected lowercase letters
Secondary title uses a heavy, italicized, extended sans-serif
Background monogram uses thick, beveled 3D block letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: 3D monogram features sharp, chiseled edges and internal reflections
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic script and rigid, geometric extended sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, handwritten feel of the primary title
Matches the wide, technical look of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A group of four men in black tank tops and bandanas posing on motorcycles on a coastal road. Bright blue sky with scattered clouds. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D metallic silver monogram in the sky. Layer a white script title over the monogram. Place a wide, italicized white sans-serif title at the bottom center with a black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the script title legible against the monogram?
Is the bottom text sufficiently extended and italicized?
Does the 3D monogram have a chrome-like reflection?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth on the background monogram
Ensure the script font is bold enough to stand out
Verify the extended sans-serif is properly italicized
Confirm the lighting on the subjects matches the sky
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Group + Coastal Background + 3D Metallic Monogram + Script/Extended Sans-Serif Pairing
